name: What are common mistakes to avoid when installing under cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid when installing under cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include improper placement, leading to uneven lighting or glare. Using the wrong type of lighting for the task or aesthetic can also be an issue, such as bright puck lights for general task lighting. Inadequate power supply or incorrect wiring can lead to flickering or system failure. Failing to conceal wires properly detracts from the aesthetic. It's crucial to plan the layout, choose appropriate fixtures, and ensure all electrical work is up to code to avoid these common pitfalls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid improper placement, wrong lighting types, inadequate power, incorrect wiring, and visible wires for a successful installation.
